title: Pure macropore drainable-storage calculation

source.behavior: When macropore bottom is below the drain base, calculate volume under the drain using VOLUNDR from a half-compartment-offset bottom; subtract it from domain storage and clamp at zero. Otherwise the under-drain volume is zero.

scope: composition of the separately source-tested VOLUNDR equation
drain-base condition and zero lower bound
100,000 deterministic bitwise comparisons at O0 and O2
non_goals: rapid-drainage conductivity, head response or event amount
whole-column mass receipt, transaction/restart owner or production admission
